Dataset collection consent
I confirm that I am at least 18, that these are my own recordings, and that I agree to the following collection notice.

Purpose and contents. Fovea Labs LLC may collect and use my selected eye/camera recordings, capture labels and timing, capture/camera metadata, free-text HMD description and consent evidence to develop, train, test and evaluate EyeTrackVR eye-tracking models. I permit processing for that specific purpose; I retain any rights I hold in my contribution.

Model releases. Raw recordings remain private. Trained models and related software may be publicly released and used by others under their published licenses. Withdrawal removes the source contribution from future use and managed datasets. Already released models or independent copies may not be fully recallable; Fovea Labs LLC will assess affected outputs and take any further steps required by applicable law.

Dataset retention. Raw dataset content is kept for no longer than 365 days after submission, or removed earlier following withdrawal or rejection, subject to the cleanup and backup periods below.

Controller and contact. Fovea Labs LLC operates this collection for EyeTrackVR. For privacy questions or rights requests, email support@fovea-labs.com.

Your choice. Contributing is optional and is not required to use EyeTrackVR. Only adults aged 18 or older may contribute, and only data about themselves. Do not upload another person's recordings, private communications, passwords, access tokens, or other people's personal information. We do not ask for your name, email address, account, headset serial number, date of birth, or installation identifier. Review the files before agreeing. Recordings and logs may still identify you; this service does not guarantee anonymity.

Security and recipients. The app encrypts the contribution before upload. Private recordings and report contents may be decrypted only by authorized Fovea Labs LLC maintainers. Cloudflare processes encrypted storage, service metadata and network connections for hosting and human verification. The service currently uses Western North America storage and international service processing; data is not promised to remain exclusively in the EU. The applicable processor agreements and transfer safeguards must cover that processing. Raw contributions are not published or sold through this collection.

Legal basis. We rely on your affirmative consent for the contribution's stated purpose. Short-lived pseudonymous network counters and connection processing protect the service against abuse in our legitimate interests. We do not use contributions for identity recognition or unrelated advertising.

Retention and withdrawal. Keep the private receipt to withdraw through the app or CLI. Withdrawal stops future use of the contribution and immediately blocks its hosted download; scheduled cleanup removes hosted content after a short in-flight-upload grace period, normally within the next cleanup batches. Maintainers must refresh managed datasets before training and remove withdrawn managed copies. A minimal consent/deletion record, without the recording, report text or HMD description, is retained for up to 365 days after hosted-content deletion, then removed. Network counters expire after approximately two to three days. Cloudflare D1 recovery history can retain deleted metadata for a further seven days on the current Free plan (up to 30 days if upgraded). Backups and restored systems must honor withdrawals.

Your rights. Contact support@fovea-labs.com to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability where applicable, or to object to security processing. You can withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. Losing your receipt does not remove your rights: contact us so we can reasonably locate your contribution without creating an identity database. You may complain to your relevant data-protection authority. These terms do not waive statutory rights.
